# Godot creation after a model stops early

Creation instructions distinguish the Godot source project from the legacy voxel
draft. The voxel ground height is not an engine-wide coordinate rule. After
compaction, an agent continues the player's original request rather than treating
the historical summary as a request to write another summary.

P8 acceptance may send at most three fixed follow-up prompts in the same case,
world and session when a completed model turn has not produced a new ready
candidate. Each follow-up uses the real product prompt API and keeps the existing
source. It cannot supply arbitrary prompts, change identity, or continue active,
failed or aborted turns. A stop suppresses subsequent turns and cases. All turns
retain separate usage, responses, tool calls and visible metrics evidence.

Model stopping is not proof of creation. Acceptance still requires a real built
candidate, preserved formal progress, preview, application, gameplay inspection,
save, restart and strict client shutdown. No fixed-authored content substitutes
for the model. Prior failed runs remain unchanged.
